comment: Describes every setting so the GUI can render controls for it, and so docs/config.md can be generated from it. A section carrying both `page` and `keys` renders as the page -- that wins -- while the keys still reach the generated reference, which is how a setting that needs more than a control in the window is still documented as the config key it is. Deliberately the same shape as the `config` block in a widget.json, so one renderer handles built-in settings and third-party widgets alike.

sections.label: Panel
sections.description: Where the panel sits and how big it is.

panel.position.label: Position
panel.position.description: Which edge the panel is anchored to.

panel.thickness.label: Thickness
panel.thickness.description: Height of a horizontal panel, width of a vertical one.

panel.autoHide.label: Hide until pointed at
panel.autoHide.description: The panel shrinks to a sliver and comes back when the pointer reaches the screen edge. It reserves no space while hidden, so windows use the whole screen.

sections.label: Drawn by
sections.description: What draws the panel. Only one of these can draw at a time, and switching is a real change to your desktop rather than a setting -- so it happens here, with a restore point, rather than as a value you can type.

panel.renderer.label: Drawn by
panel.renderer.description: Which of them draws the panel. Only one can, so two panels at one screen edge is not a state this can reach. Changing it by hand only tells the shell; the shell package, the applet layout and the restore point are the CLI's job -- use `rmpr renderer set`.

sections.label: Launcher
sections.description: What opens when you press the start button, and what opens when you search.

launcher.provider.label: Application menu
launcher.provider.description: Kickoff is Plasma's own menu, but it opens at whichever panel holds plasmashell's launcher applet rather than at this one.

launcher.kickoffMode.label: Kickoff style
launcher.kickoffMode.description: Windowed opens Kickoff as an ordinary window; slower, and it will not close itself when it loses focus.

sections.label: On-screen display
sections.description: The volume and brightness popup. Plasma draws it by default and works well; ours exists for the placement and animation a Plasma OSD cannot do. Turning ours on without silencing Plasma's shows both -- 'rmpr theme osd ours' silences it.

osd.enabled.label: Draw our own
osd.enabled.description: Listens to the same signals Plasma's OSD does. Nothing is taken over, and turning it off leaves Plasma exactly as it was.

sections.label: Layouts
sections.description: Shipped panel layouts. Applying one replaces your current configuration.

sections.label: Widgets
sections.description: What appears on the panel, and in which zone.

sections.label: Profiles
sections.description: Separate configurations you can switch between, and per-monitor overrides within each.

sections.label: Restore points
sections.description: Snapshots of your KDE configuration. Nothing here is ever deleted automatically.
